name: print-social-purple-fintech-3d-character-posts
title: Purple fintech ads with 3D characters holding phones
whatItIs: Four square ads in vibrant violet. Each pairs a 3D-rendered person with a phone or cash, large white headlines like 'Move Money in Seconds', app store badges, and a frosted label in the middle naming the project.
whatItMeans: Energetic, friendly and youthful; a fun take on money without losing clarity.
techniques: Use one saturated purple background with white type for strong contrast.
Feature stylised 3D characters interacting with phones to show the product story.
Float cash and coin props in the composition to add motion.
Overlay a frosted glass label to title the set.

vocabulary.definition: A stylised rendered person or mascot.
A group of ads sharing one style.
App Store or Google Play buttons.
